title: Sprint Engine role manifest
description: A declarative Sprint Engine role (v2). Pure data: the runtime composes the agent prompt from the referenced skill ids. No code is executed, so third-party roles are safe to install (Tier 1). A role is routing + directive packs — `directives.implement` composes the owner's startup brief, `directives.<phase>` adds role-scoped content to that phase's shared base pack, and `sweep` marks a fix-forward sweep role. Mirror of src/shared/sprintengine/role-manifest.ts and sprintengine_core/role_registry.py.

summary.description: One-line description of what the role does.

icon.description: Optional icon id for role lists.

aliases.description: Alternate ids that resolve to this role.

directives.description: Directive packs keyed by lifecycle step. `implement` is required; each post-implementation phase key adds role-scoped content to that phase's shared base pack.

sweep.description: Present only on sweep roles. A sweep is an ordinary fix-forward task planned late in the graph: the role reviews the combined branch diff (or exercises the finished work) and directly fixes what it finds. Null or absent for a worker role.

focus.description: What this sweep audits, e.g. "authn/authz, input handling, secrets".

when.description: The risk trigger the architect reads at plan time, e.g. "run touches auth, network boundary, or user input".

directiveList.description: Ordered skill references composing this directive pack.
